name: Document360
description: Document360 is an AI-powered knowledge base platform for creating, managing, and delivering internal and external documentation, including software docs, SOPs, and API docs.
best_for: Serves multiple roles (support teams, technical writers, product managers, engineers) across industries such as SaaS, IT/consulting, financial services, healthcare, education, manufacturing, retail, and nonprofits, for both internal knowledge bases and external customer/API documentation.
features: AI-powered conversational search grounded in your articles, plus an AI chatbot
AI writing agent that generates documentation from videos and files
MCP Server integration with ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot
Custom workflow builder, PDF/Word import, PDF export
SSO/SCIM, role-based access, IP restriction, SOC2 and ISO 27001:2022 certification

pricing.starting_price: Customized pricing; contact Document360 after the 14-day trial

tiers.name: Paid plan
tiers.notes: Customized quote based on setup and requirements.

cons: Document360 does not publish a numeric self-serve rate card; after the 14-day no-card trial, buyers need a customized quote.
Pricing is tailored to the deployment and requirements, so total cost cannot be inferred from a simple public seat price.

alternatives.name: ReadMe
alternatives.description: A developer-focused API documentation platform with an interactive API explorer and Git-based workflows.
alternatives.best_for: API-first teams wanting docs tightly integrated with OpenAPI specs and code repos.

alternatives.name: Slite
alternatives.description: An AI knowledge base that auto-detects when docs drift out of sync with connected tools.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting continuously self-maintaining internal documentation.
